architecture: Frozen SmolLM2-135M body and LM head; two private normalized-hidden linear heads adjust only first-token Yes/No logits. All vocabulary tokens compete.
custody: Operator-authored synthetic development task worlds, labels visible to investigators; no sealed curator/independent evaluator.
eligibility: Frozen action-time hidden feature and prediction expectation; receipt delivered exactly3 paired-action clock steps later. Sequence delay is not a biological/real-time claim.
eval_label_access: Evaluation file bytes are hashed for source and data pins before training; labels are first parsed as JSON and used for scoring only after all16 candidates are saved and frozen.
failure_policy: One exclusive attempt, per-task generation failures retained in fixed denominators; setup failures and partial journals retained, uncertain jobs reconciled without new key.
feedback: Same external ordered two-coordinate label vector for every arm; only routed vs swapped uses identical full information. Scalar projects mean; no_eligibility zeroes recorded trace.
groups: Content prompt domain (color or shape), never target label. Retention group fixed by source-cluster index.
parser: Full string, optional single period or exclamation mark; explanations and extra words invalid.
primary_metric: Exact YES/NO answer correct/64. Invalid or failed generations count incorrect.
retention_competency_gate: Base correct>=24/32 and valid>=28/32; otherwise no retention adequacy claim.
retention_origin_source: #6132 0e6634cadf4497c653e191e50e6394387190ca55 prospective retention32; deliberately reused descriptive development control, not new independent tasks.
tokenizer_material: Only fast tokenizer, with vocabulary and merges contained in pinned tokenizer.json. No separate vocab.json/merges.txt are present or used in this native model directory.
